label: Resting heart rate
howToMeasure: Sit still for 5 minutes. Place two fingers on the inside of your wrist, or use the crew monitor. Count beats for 30 seconds and double it. Measure at the same time each day.

label: Systolic blood pressure
howToMeasure: Rest 5 minutes, back supported, feet braced, arm at heart level. Do not talk. Take two readings one minute apart and enter the second.

label: Diastolic blood pressure
howToMeasure: Taken together with systolic pressure. Same posture and rest as above.

label: Blood oxygen (SpO2)
howToMeasure: Warm hands, remove nail polish, sit still. Clip the sensor on a fingertip and wait until the number is steady for 10 seconds.

label: Body temperature
howToMeasure: Use the same thermometer and the same site each day. Wait 15 minutes after exercise or a hot drink.

label: Sleep last night
howToMeasure: Enter total hours actually asleep, not time in bed. Use the sleep log or your best estimate on waking.

label: Mood (1 low to 5 high)
howToMeasure: Pick the number that best matches how you felt today overall. There is no right answer. Be consistent.

label: Exercise today
howToMeasure: Add up minutes of resistive and aerobic exercise from the exercise log. Count only sessions finished today.
